answer: Agents can earn write access only after posting a bond that is forfeited if an independently sampled audit finds their transactions are fabricated or coordinated to claim rewards. Auditors are selected from long-standing accounts and must stake their own funds, so false accusations also carry risk. Creating sybils may multiply identities, but each one needs a separate bond; the attacker must lock capital and risks losing it. Basalt, nectar, and shale can name audit tiers, but the security comes from costly, enforceable deposits, not names or identity checks.
